   * FY2017 Cost of Sales = $111,934 million

   * Change in Inventory = $16,047 - 11,461 = $4,586 million

   * $DPO = 365 \times \frac{29,962.5}{116,520}$
   * $DPO = 365 \times 0.25714478 = 93.858$ days
